# SARIF schema provenance

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the unmodified official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 Errata01 schema, downloaded September 27, 2026 from:

https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json

Its declared schema dialect is JSON Schema draft-04. Validation uses the maintained AJV validator with draft-04 and standard format support. The source specification, including OASIS notices, is available at:

https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/sarif-v2.1.0-errata01-os-complete.html

The schema establishes structure; it does not establish source consistency, publication readiness, or host eligibility. Product policy performs those checks separately.
